none: PAS LON-1E56D5: Fragment of a Roman samian ware dish that has had a circular hole punched through the center of the base, AD.50-200.
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

Fragment of a Roman samian ware dish that has had a circular hole punched through the center of the base, AD.50-200. The fragment consists of the base of a dish or bowl that has been broken off around the foot ring. The foot ring has been kept intact aside from some minor damage and a hole has been punched through the center of the base. There is a large amount of surface damage to the inside…
